<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Elemental Transformation](/Feats.aspx?ID=4198) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=127" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 23

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
exactly one kinetic element

**Requirements**
Your kinetic gate is deactivated.

</column>

---

You open your kinetic gate, but rather than activating your kinetic aura, you instead become overwhelmed with transformative elemental energy. You're affected by an [_elemental form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=98) spell with the same trait as your kinetic element. You can heighten it to any spell rank up to half your level rounded up.
name: Elemental Transformation
